## Problem and result

Describe the website problem, affected pages/workflow and resulting behavior. Link a related Issue when applicable.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Include screenshots for visual changes and explain any skipped checks or remaining limitations.

- [ ] Scope is limited to the website; product changes use the product repository.
- [ ] English and Chinese copy are aligned where affected.
- [ ] Relevant tests, content generation, lint, types and build pass; `git diff --check` is clean.
- [ ] Visual changes have phone, keyboard and light/dark checks, or are not applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, local databases or generated output are included; imported notices and evidence boundaries are preserved.
